references.title: Super-Snell scanning light-field display (Nature Photonics, 2026)
references.use: Published reference and trade-off analysis; not assumed to be reproduced

references.title: Quantifying spatial and angular resolution of light field 3D displays
Symtropy visual optics reference package
references.use: Analytic geometry reference; not a full light-field optics model

evidence_lanes.software_synthetic: Deterministic metadata/model negative controls; no physical-performance or upstream legal-rights claim.
evidence_lanes.physical_measurement: Requires named device, calibration, angle/depth geometry, instruments, raw data and uncertainty.

cases.title: Usable viewing-angle envelope, not nominal field of view
cases.expected_behavior: Report nominal optical angle separately from usable angle. A point counts as usable only if preregistered luminance, MTF, crosstalk and geometric-error floors are all met.
failure_modes: nominal angle reported as usable angle
cases.claim_limit: The 150-degree sweep is a proposed test range motivated by one 2026 paper, not a universal target or an assumed result.

cases.title: Center-view spatial resolution at reference depth
cases.expected_behavior: Report horizontal and vertical MTF/MTF50/MTF10 and chart result at the stated depth; retain raw captures and optics/display settings.
failure_modes: panel pixel count treated as reconstructed resolution
cases.claim_limit: Only applies to the named device/configuration and center view.

cases.title: Off-axis resolution degradation
cases.expected_behavior: Measure angle-resolved MTF and compare with center view using the same chart, camera geometry, exposure policy and luminance floor.
failure_modes: changed exposure or focus between angle samples
cases.claim_limit: If the device cannot support an angle, mark not applicable rather than fabricating a measurement.

cases.title: Resolution and geometry at 20 mm image depth
cases.expected_behavior: Measure spatial fidelity, depth-plane placement, focus and view consistency for the declared 20 mm depth plane.
failure_modes: rendered depth treated as physically reconstructed depth
depth target inferred only from software
cases.claim_limit: Depth applies to the selected optical setup and viewing geometry.

cases.title: Resolution and geometry at 40 mm image depth
cases.expected_behavior: Measure fidelity and depth-plane error separately from the 0 and 20 mm cases; preserve results even when the device does not support that plane.
failure_modes: depth performance generalized from one plane
cases.claim_limit: This is a test plane, not a promised device capability.

cases.title: Known-depth ordering and reconstruction error
cases.expected_behavior: Verify the relative order and measured position of each plane from defined viewing positions; report error and uncertainty per plane.
failure_modes: qualitative 3D impression treated as depth accuracy
cases.claim_limit: No claim of natural accommodation cues from depth ordering alone.

cases.title: Adjacent-view optical crosstalk

stimulus.pattern: one view white, adjacent views black; reverse roles

cases.expected_behavior: Measure leakage into neighboring angular views under a fixed pattern and instrument configuration.
failure_modes: black floor below instrument resolution reported as zero
cases.claim_limit: Use a declared crosstalk definition and do not compare unlike instruments or patterns.

cases.title: View-zone continuity and aliasing

stimulus.pattern: moving vertical line with sub-degree viewpoint increments

cases.expected_behavior: Detect view discontinuities, repeated/reversed viewpoints, aliasing and geometry jumps as the observer moves through measured angles.
failure_modes: measurements only at nominal view centers
cases.claim_limit: Interpolation between sampled views is not evidence of continuous parallax.

cases.title: Absolute luminance map over angle and depth
cases.expected_behavior: Measure absolute luminance and uniformity at each valid angle/depth under stated ambient conditions; preserve raw radiometry and instrument calibration.
failure_modes: camera RGB treated as absolute radiometry
cases.claim_limit: No brightness result can be inferred from the paper's reported relative luminance tradeoff.

cases.title: Brightness-conditioned useful-viewing-angle frontier

stimulus.preregistered_luminance_floor_cd_m2: set before measurement for target environment

cases.expected_behavior: Calculate useful viewing angle only where all preregistered image-quality and brightness thresholds are met; publish each threshold and failed region.
failure_modes: wide angle counted despite unreadable/dim image
cases.claim_limit: The correct floor depends on target environment and task; do not use one universal threshold.

cases.title: Color and white-point shift across viewing angles
cases.expected_behavior: Report color error and white-point shift by angle with colorimeter/spectroradiometer profile and uncertainty.
failure_modes: uncalibrated RGB camera used as spectroradiometer
cases.claim_limit: Color-space coverage alone does not demonstrate color fidelity across views.

cases.title: Static scene reconstruction fidelity

stimulus.reference: same scene with calibrated source captures

cases.expected_behavior: Compare each view and depth plane against the reference using declared geometric and photometric metrics; keep synthetic references distinct from measurements.
failure_modes: post-processing differs between candidate and reference
cases.claim_limit: Image similarity does not independently prove depth cues or temporal fidelity.

cases.title: Dynamic-scene temporal fidelity under scan

stimulus.capture: high-speed synchronized capture if apparatus supports it

cases.expected_behavior: Measure motion distortion, tearing, ghosting, view switching and end-to-end temporal behavior separately from static quality. Unsupported rates remain not evaluated.
failure_modes: still images used as dynamic evidence
nominal refresh substituted for captured frame timing
cases.claim_limit: 60 Hz is a proposed test profile, not a minimum universal device specification.

cases.title: Long-exposure capture cannot hide scan artifacts

comparison: short synchronized exposure or high-speed capture

cases.expected_behavior: Demonstrate that report conclusions are not based only on a long exposure that averages temporal behavior; disclose exposure and synchronized timing for every capture.
failure_modes: long exposure mistaken for motion clarity
cases.claim_limit: The 200 ms value is a control motivated by a published figure, not a universal capture requirement.

cases.title: Scan synchronization drift over sustained operation

stimulus.record: scan phase, trigger, frame timestamps and image registration

cases.expected_behavior: Measure sync phase/drift over repeated sustained runs and retain time series; report restarts and calibration changes.
failure_modes: single scan reported as long-term stability
cases.claim_limit: The 30-minute duration is a proposed baseline; longer life testing is a separate gate.

cases.title: Power, heat and sustained brightness tradeoff

stimulus.record: input power and temperature time series until declared steady state

cases.expected_behavior: Report power and thermal state alongside luminance/resolution. Compare configurations at matched useful image quality and state whether mechanisms/electronics are included.
failure_modes: peak brightness compared to sustained result
cases.claim_limit: No energy-saving claim without a calibrated meter and matched output conditions.

cases.title: Ambient-light robustness and contrast

stimulus.record: surface reflectance and incident light geometry

cases.expected_behavior: Measure contrast and usable-angle changes in each declared environment; report when the device becomes unsuitable rather than extrapolating beyond tested conditions.
cases.claim_limit: The proposed lux levels are illustrative test points, not standard tiers.

cases.title: Mechanical vibration, noise and optical alignment sensitivity
cases.expected_behavior: For mechanical/scanned designs, report vibration/noise, alignment drift and safe/known degraded behavior. Mark mechanical metrics not applicable only when no relevant mechanism exists.
cases.claim_limit: This does not establish product lifetime or product safety.

cases.title: Independent-session calibration repeatability

stimulus.split: hold out one session from tuning

cases.expected_behavior: Estimate repeatability across sessions/operators and report calibration variance; tune on one subset and evaluate on held-out session.
failure_modes: same session used for tune and final result
cases.claim_limit: Three sessions/two operators is a proposed minimal fixture, not proof of broad reproducibility.

cases.title: Stale or mismatched calibration negative control
cases.expected_behavior: The evaluator must mark the measurement unqualified or require recalibration whenever device/profile identity or validity no longer matches.
cases.claim_limit: This tests metadata handling; it is not a physical calibration experiment.

cases.title: Missing/corrupted measurement artifact blocks claims
cases.expected_behavior: The evidence gate rejects or marks unknown any physical performance claim whose required measurement or context artifact is absent/corrupt.
cases.claim_limit: Correct evidence gating does not establish the measured optical result.

cases.title: Device/profile identity mismatch

mutations: results from device A labelled device B

cases.expected_behavior: Cross-device or cross-configuration results are never merged as one qualified result without an explicit compatibility/transfer study.
failure_modes: result generalized by product family name
cases.claim_limit: A matching model name is not evidence of identical optics or calibration.

cases.title: Matched-task baseline comparison

baselines: reproduced SSS-LiD method if rights/hardware permit
stimulus.content: same rights-cleared source scenes, target size and stated ambient

cases.expected_behavior: Compare only metrics appropriate to the task and disclose incomparable dimensions. A 2D baseline can benchmark a 2D task but cannot claim equivalent multi-view depth.
failure_modes: published headline treated as reproduced result
cases.claim_limit: No single universal baseline spans every display architecture.

cases.title: Published code/dataset identity and reuse-rights check

stimulus.capture: repository commit/version, archive digest, license and terms snapshots

cases.expected_behavior: A synthetic fixture requires exact source artifact identities and a rights-state field; unknown/uncleared rights block distribution. This test checks the gate logic, not that upstream rights have been verified.
failure_modes: source tree changes without pinned commit
cases.claim_limit: This case tests provenance-gate behavior only. Actual upstream code/data identity, license terms and permissions remain unverified until a source audit is recorded.
